dataCenters.name: Meta New Albany Data Center
dataCenters.locationNote: Approximate city marker; not a verified campus boundary or street address.
dataCenters.summary: Meta operates a large, multi-building campus south of SR-161. Official records document a 600+ acre site, active city-listed building projects, regional-grid power, city utility context, and a July 2026 noise issue under mitigation. Housing and tax figures below describe New Albany and must be checked against a specific address.

facts.label: Identity and operator
facts.value: Meta New Albany Data Center
facts.scope: Meta New Albany campus

facts.label: Reported status
facts.value: Operational
facts.scope: Meta New Albany campus

facts.label: CAMPUS · Site footprint
facts.value: More than 600 acres south of SR-161
facts.scope: Meta New Albany campus; current site area reported by the City, not acres of building footprint

source.label: City of New Albany: Our Community

facts.label: DEVELOPMENT · Current building records
facts.value: City-listed Meta buildings range from 13,243 to 302,944 square feet
facts.scope: Individual Meta-labeled commercial projects on the City's monthly project page; this is a range, not a total campus area

source.label: City of New Albany: Project Updates

facts.label: QUALITY OF LIFE · Reported noise
facts.value: Periodic campus noise reported in July 2026; mitigation work is underway
facts.scope: Meta campus south of SR-161, including work along Morse Road; no home-specific sound reading is published

source.label: City of New Albany: Neighbor Noise Update

facts.label: QUALITY OF LIFE · Noise response
facts.value: Phased fan ramp-up, a temporary sound wall, possible berm or permanent wall, and sound attenuating equipment
facts.scope: Mitigation steps reported by the City for the Meta New Albany campus after the July 2026 complaint

source.label: City of New Albany: Neighbor Noise Update

facts.label: WATER · Utility system
facts.value: Water and sewer are provided by the City of Columbus under contract
facts.scope: New Albany businesses; citywide utility arrangement, not Meta-specific consumption

source.label: City of New Albany: Our Community

facts.label: WATER · Capacity context
facts.value: The City says data centers have not required additional water capacity
facts.scope: All New Albany data centers; City statement does not publish a Meta campus daily-use figure

source.label: City of New Albany: Data Center FAQs

facts.label: POWER & BILLS · Grid arrangement
facts.value: The campus draws from the regional electric grid; the City says Meta pays the full cost of the energy it uses
facts.scope: Meta New Albany campus; this does not quantify household-rate effects

source.label: City of New Albany: Meta Energy Statement

facts.label: INFRASTRUCTURE · Meta-linked expansion
facts.value: Meta revenue supported Beech Road corridor road, water, and sewer work that opened more than 800 acres for development
facts.scope: City-reported infrastructure financing and economic-development effect; not a household savings estimate

source.label: City of New Albany: Our Community

facts.label: COST OF LIVING · Home value
facts.value: $772,100 median owner-occupied home value
facts.scope: New Albany city, 2020–2024 Census estimate; area context, not a Meta-caused change or current listing price

source.label: U.S. Census Bureau: New Albany QuickFacts

facts.label: COST OF LIVING · Rent
facts.value: $2,355 median monthly gross rent
facts.scope: New Albany city, 2020–2024 Census estimate; gross rent includes contract rent plus applicable utilities and fuels

source.label: U.S. Census Bureau: New Albany QuickFacts

facts.label: COST OF LIVING · Owner costs
facts.value: $3,737 median monthly owner cost with a mortgage
facts.scope: New Albany city, 2020–2024 Census estimate; includes selected ownership costs and is not a payment quote

source.label: U.S. Census Bureau: New Albany QuickFacts

facts.label: TAXES · Household property-tax reference
facts.value: $2,421.88 annually per $100,000 of fair market value for 2025
facts.scope: Tax District 222 only: City of New Albany, Franklin County, New Albany-Plain schools, and Plain Township Fire; verify the exact parcel district

facts.label: TAXES · Municipal income tax
facts.value: 2.0% on earned income, with a 100% credit up to 2.0% for tax paid to another municipality
facts.scope: City of New Albany residents; jurisdiction can differ even with a New Albany mailing address

facts.label: PUBLIC FINANCE · Data-center revenue
facts.value: Approximately $10 million in community development charges for tax year 2024
facts.scope: All New Albany data-center projects combined; the City does not attribute this total to Meta alone

source.label: City of New Albany: City Finances

facts.label: PUBLIC FINANCE · Incentive oversight
facts.value: Real-property abatements are reviewed annually by the Tax Incentive Review Council
facts.scope: Citywide CRA abatements; specific agreement terms and parcel taxes must be checked separately

source.label: City of New Albany: City Finances

alerts.title: DeKalb began serving traffic
alerts.description: Meta announced that its DeKalb data center was online. This historical announcement replaces the unsupported 2026 opening forecast.

alerts.title: Mesa electricity reporting for 2025
alerts.description: Apple’s 2026 environmental report provides annual electricity use for Mesa. This is historical operating data, not a new construction announcement.

alerts.title: City reports Meta campus noise mitigation
alerts.description: After periodic noise was reported in July 2026, the City said Meta changed fan ramp-up, planned to reconstruct a temporary sound wall along Morse Road, began assessing a berm or permanent wall, and was installing sound attenuating equipment.

source.label: City of New Albany: Neighbor Noise Update

alerts.title: City clarifies the campus power arrangement
alerts.description: The City said Meta's New Albany campus draws power from the regional electric grid, Meta pays the full cost of its energy, and no nuclear generation facility is planned in New Albany as part of Meta's announced energy agreements.

source.label: City of New Albany: Meta Energy Statement
